name: Google Ads Management
description: O3M provides Google Ads management services focused on qualified leads, sales readiness, and measurable business outcomes — not just clicks. Google Premier Partner.

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads management is the ongoing process of planning, running, tracking, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Google platforms. Good management focuses on business outcomes such as qualified leads, sales opportunities, ecommerce revenue, and customer acquisition — not only clicks or impressions.

mainEntity.name: How much should I spend on Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right budget depends on your industry, competition, customer value, and growth objectives. O3M recommends a discovery conversation to assess your specific situation before recommending a starting point.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with B2B companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. O3M has significant experience supporting manufacturing and B2B businesses where long sales cycles, distributor networks, and lead quality are critical considerations.
Yes. O3M manages YouTube advertising campaigns as part of broader Google Ads strategies, including awareness and remarketing objectives.

mainEntity.name: How does O3M improve Google Ads lead quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: O3M improves Google Ads lead quality by reviewing campaign targeting, keywords, conversion tracking, landing pages, forms, CRM processes, and sales follow-up. This helps reduce wasted enquiries and improves the connection between advertising spend and business outcomes.
